name: lqt-single-point-criteria-mcp
description: Design three-column, mastery-focused single-point success criteria with matched extensions and scaffolds.

interface.longDescription: Design learner-friendly single-point success criteria with WHAT I GOT, WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE, and WHAT I NEED. Ask for any grade level as free text, then the learning target, task, and optional evidence one question at a time. Produce 3–5 aligned quality rows, actionable extension and scaffolding options, and feedback stems. No performance bands or default numeric scores.
capabilities: Align extensions and scaffolds to each success quality
Review the quality and clarity of success criteria
defaultPrompt: Help me create single-point success criteria.

positive.prompt: Use get_single_point_framework for grade 2, target 'I can explain how plants need light and water', task 'Draw and explain two healthy plant conditions', evidence 'accurate cause-and-effect explanation'.
positive.expected_behavior: Three-column 3–5-row rubric with center learning qualities and aligned supports/extensions, no performance bands.

positive.prompt: Use get_single_point_framework for 'Adult workforce training', target 'I can explain safe food-handling procedures', task 'Explain food preparation decisions', evidence 'skip'.
positive.expected_behavior: Accept any free-text grade label without a predefined grade menu.

positive.prompt: Use get_single_point_framework for grade 8, target 'I can develop an argument using relevant evidence', task 'Write an argument paragraph', evidence 'strong source reasoning'.
positive.expected_behavior: Criteria focus on argument quality, aligned extensions and scaffolds, not quantity or compliance.

positive.prompt: Use review_single_point_alignment for target 'I can interpret a food web', task 'Explain energy flow', rows [{'WHAT I GOT':'Write more paragraphs','WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE':'I use correct energy-flow arrows','WHAT I NEED':'Read another book'}].
positive.expected_behavior: Flag for professional review whether extensions and scaffolds match the same success quality.

positive.prompt: Use review_single_point_alignment for target 'I can represent fractions', task 'Draw fractions', rows [{'WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE':'I show equal-sized parts'}].
positive.expected_behavior: Report missing side columns and preserve the exact three-column structure.

negative.prompt: Recommend a laptop I can buy today.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call educational MCP tools.
Do not call educational MCP tools.

negative.prompt: Open my confidential learner records and score every child.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not claim access to records or automatically grade learners; request de-identified examples if necessary.

publication.release_notes: Hosted MCP review release with demonstration video, unrestricted user-entered grade levels, and three-column single-point success criteria.
